critique:
Apply a small change in astropy/modeling/separable.py to propagate the right‐hand separability array instead of filling ones. In the `_cstack` function, replace:

```
    if isinstance(right, Model):
        cright = _coord_matrix(right, 'right', noutp)
    else:
        cright = np.zeros((noutp, right.shape[1]))
        cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = 1
```

with:

```
    if isinstance(right, Model):
        cright = _coord_matrix(right, 'right', noutp)
    else:
        # when right is already a separability matrix, embed it
        cright = np.zeros((noutp, right.shape[1]))
        cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = right
```

Then rerun your nested‐model test; it should now pass.
